subject: CedarBridge VPC - runtime regression & immediate standup request
messages:
From: Stephanie Lang <stephanie.lang@cedarbridge.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@cedarbridge.com>, sre@cedarbridge.com
Date: 2027-05-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Rapid P99 spikes since Friday afternoon - help requested

Marissa,

We're seeing a sharp increase in tail latency and a handful of 500s from our private VPC deployment running on your runtime. The symptoms started Friday ~17:30 PDT after we applied the new quantization profile you recommended (int8-mixed). P50 is fine but P95/P99 have moved up ~3x and there are intermittent failures returning "decode_timeout" and "kv-cache-miss" in the logs. Attachments: cedarbridge-error-dumps-20270509.tar.gz contains the stack traces and container logs.

This is impacting search and customer checkout flows. We're paused on rolling the change further and would like Redwood to triage ASAP. Can we get an ops/infra standup in the next 90 minutes?

- Stephanie
VP Product, CedarBridge

Attachment: cedarbridge-error-dumps-20270509.tar.gz (log archive)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Stephanie Lang <stephanie.lang@cedarbridge.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-09T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rapid P99 spikes since Friday afternoon - help requested

Stephanie — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We're assembling a triage group now. Preliminary ask: can you confirm whether the traffic mix changed (longer prompt contexts, higher stop-token usage) after the profile change? Also confirm whether the rollout included the model variant switch (v2.1 -> v2.1-quant).

I'll schedule a 30-min standup at 09:00 PDT and loop in our on-call infra and the runtime team. Vivek and Priyom - please pull the drive link I just created (INVESTIGATION folder) and start with the kv-cache and batching telemetry. Evelyn, please prepare the most recent tracer spans and per-shard token latency.

Next steps in the standup: reproduce at small scale, identify whether the regression is kernel/quant side or request routing/backpressure, consider temporary rollback to previous quant profile if needed.

— Marissa
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: Stephanie Lang <stephanie.lang@cedarbridge.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Standup notes + immediate checks

On 2027-05-09 at 09:00 PDT we ran the standup with CedarBridge SREs. Quick summary:
- Repro: We ran synthetic traffic against a canary replica with the same quant profile and observed P99 jump from ~320ms to ~980ms when sequences exceeded 512 tokens. Failures correlate with higher KV cache miss rates and increased decode retries.
- Telemetry: Batching decreased from 12->5 avg requests per batch; throughput dropped ~40% under sustained load.
- Config change: CedarBridge toggled kernel pinning for GPU-affinity as part of the maintenance window. That combined with the int8-mixed code path seems to amplify cache churn.

Immediate mitigation applied:
1) Rolled back kernel pinning on one canary host (immediate P99 improvement to ~420ms).
2) Disabled aggressive batch splitting in the runtime config to allow larger batches while we investigate.

Action items: Vivek to run a focused KV-cache stress test and collect per-shard hotkey distribution; Priyom to run a microbenchmark comparing v2.1-quant vs v2.1 float32 on the customer's exact prompt distribution; Evelyn to assemble trace-level waterfall for the degraded window. CedarBridge to pause full rollout.

Attachments: cb_kvcache_snapshot-20270509.log

- Priyom
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: Stephanie Lang <stephanie.lang@cedarbridge.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-10T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Mid-investigation update — kernel interaction & hotkeys

Team — quick update from the overnight run:
- Hotkey skew: 3% of client prompts accounted for ~38% of KV lookups; those hotkeys have poor locality after quantization due to slight tokenization differences introduced in the preprocessing pipeline.
- Kernel behavior: When kernel pinning is enabled, we see CPU-GPU scheduling jitter that increases cache eviction rates on the int8 execution path. Float32 path doesn't show the same sensitivity.
- Repro test: Replicated at scale in our lab with 16 shard config; applying a lightweight prefix-normalization on the customer tokenization reduced miss-rate by ~60% and improved P99 to ~360ms.

Proposed short-term plan (for CedarBridge):
- Keep kernel pinning disabled on all hosts until fix is validated.
- Apply tokenization normalization as a prompt-side transform in the VPC preprocessor for a rolling pilot (low risk).
- Schedule a follow-up for a deeper fix in the runtime that reduces int8 cache churn (timeline: 2-3 weeks).

Requested from CedarBridge: approval to deploy the prompt normalization pilot to 10% of traffic and permission to keep the rollback in place for 48 hours.

Attachment: runtime-change-summary.pdf

- Vivek
Director, Runtime Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Park <tom.park@cedarbridge.com>
To: Stephanie Lang <stephanie.lang@cedarbridge.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-11T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CedarBridge VPC - runtime regression & immediate standup request

Marissa / team — thank you for the quick turnaround and the clear remediation steps. CedarBridge approves the 10% pilot for prompt normalization and agrees to keep kernel pinning disabled for 72 hours to gather stable telemetry.

Two asks from our side: 1) Can Redwood provide an SLA credit estimate for the degraded window (May 7-9)? 2) We'd like a single-slide exec summary for our CTO and board covering root cause and planned timelines by EOD Friday.

We'll keep the rollout on hold and feed any anomalies into INF-11247. Appreciate the responsiveness.

— Tom
Head of Infrastructure, CedarBridge
